topic.title: 만성 질환 전문의 상담
topic.description: 만성 질환 전문의와의 상담을 위한 기본적인 영어 회화 연습입니다.

korean_scripts.korean_text: 안녕하세요, 저는 오늘 만성 질환 전문의와 상담이 있어요.
네, 예약 확인되었습니다. 어떤 점이 불편하신가요?
저는 몇 달 동안 계속 피로를 느껴요.
알겠습니다. 이전에 진단받은 만성 질환이 있으신가요?
네, 점점 더 나빠지는 것 같아요.
그렇다면 몇 가지 검사를 해보고 가장 적절한 치료법을 찾아봐야겠네요.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Hello, I have an appointment with the chronic condition specialist today.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Hello, | I have an appointment | with the chronic condition specialist today.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Yes, your appointment is confirmed. What are you feeling unwell with?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Yes, | your appointment is confirmed. | What are you feeling unwell with?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: I have been feeling tired for several months.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: I have been feeling tired | for several months.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Understood. Do you have any previously diagnosed chronic conditions?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Understood. | Do you have any | previously diagnosed chronic conditions?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Yes, I have high blood pressure.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Yes, | I have high blood pressure.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Yes, it seems to be getting worse and worse.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Yes, | it seems to be | getting worse and worse.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: In that case, we will do some tests and find the most appropriate treatment.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: In that case, | we will do some tests | and find the most appropriate treatment.
